items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: a flute player by the name of Jim Seger

ctx.x: Now let's get back to Galadora. I would practice like mad. And during the time we were playing in the quarter, the Orphan Theatre had, for 27 years, had used the old-fashioned Pitt-type band, you know, only to play vortical. And Emil Tasso, Sr., had the job for 27 years. That's where that famous remark came from, was when he came home and told his wife, I got my notice, she said, I told you it wouldn't be a steady job. You've heard that before too. That's an epic down here. But they finally gave him his notice,…
Where was Jack Asano playing? He played at the Orphan.
